summary: Spec fidelity: brief F4 says a notRun command is run by no invocation and scenario 95 says 'the command is never run'; the checker still runs '<command> --help' for a notRun command that has an option default (l1_plan.rs, the helps loop, for L1.defaults). The CHANGELOG says so, the L1 half of the test lets '--help' lines of the hung command through, and the fake tool's hangCommand never hangs on --help. canon's dashboard gets 'dashboard --help' on every L1 pass. A tool that starts serving on --help is not protected, and the report does not say the command was invoked (L1.defaults carries no notRun). Needs the author's word on whether --help counts; if not, the brief's sentence should say so. Blast radius: every notRun command with a documented default, at L1 only.
